backcard_card_text:
[Permanent] Reduce the combo cost by 1 and negate the [Energy-Exhaust] skill of all black multicolor Battle Cards with {SS4} in their card names in all of your areas.
[Auto] When this card attacks, resolve the effects below according to the number of non-black colors present among black multicolor cards in your Battle Area and Energy Area.
・2+ colors : This card gets +5000 power for the battle, then choose up to 1 of your opponent's Battle Cards and switch it to Rest Mode.
・3+ colors : At the end of the turn, switch up to 1 of your black multicolor energy to Active Mode.
・4+ colors : Draw 1 card, then choose up to 1 of your opponent's Unison Cards and remove a marker from it.
card_text:
[Permanent] Reduce the combo cost by 1 and negate the [Energy-Exhaust] skill of all black multicolor Battle Cards with {SS4} in their card names in all of your areas.
[Permanent] For each card color in your Battle Area and Energy Area, this card gets +2000 power. (Up to a maximum of +10000.)
[Auto] When this card attacks, look at up to 5 cards from the top of your deck, add up to 1 black card with {SS4} in its card name among them to your hand, then shuffle your deck.
[Awaken] When your life is at 3 or less, or you have 4 or more card colors in your Battle Area and Energy Area : You may draw 2 cards, then flip this card over.
